description: Create a crypto invoice for one new eSIM. Before calling, confirm the plan with the person and tell them when validity starts and the plan notes (number plans: validity starts at installation; Europe number is French +33; UK number plan: install only after arrival). Returns order_id, order_token, the exact amount and the address. The person must send exactly that amount on that network before expires_at. Then poll get_order. Unpaid invoices per client are limited; cancel unused ones with cancel_order.

client_ref.description: Resellers only: your own order reference, returned as is.

network.description: Network from list_payment_coins, e.g. "tron", "solana". Required for USDT (several networks).

quantity.description: Resellers with an API key only: number of identical eSIMs on one invoice (1-50). Omit otherwise.
